column1: # This is a SEED for tools/foundry-rename/naming_map.tsv — expand during implementation.
# NOTE: identifier rows are matched with a trailing word boundary, so a bare
# "prefix" row like GDVIRTUAL or GODOT_ only matches the bare token, never
# GDVIRTUAL0 / GODOT_VERSION. The concrete variants are emitted explicitly by
# generate_map.py from the live code, so no prefix-fallback rows are kept here.

column4: standalone language class (apply AFTER all GDScript* prefixes)
lowercase file/include prefix (apply BEFORE gdscript via longest-first)
lowercase module dir, main file, setting keys (apply AFTER gdscript_)

column1: # Category-A residuals: embedded / all-caps GDScript tokens the word-boundary
# engine cannot reach via the family prefixes. Explicit full-identifier rules.
# All-caps GDSCRIPT -> FOUNDRY_SCRIPT (forced by module-macro naming).
# Embedded CamelCase: GDScript segment -> FoundryScript (terminal) or FS (mid).
# Embedded snake_case: cache/member mirrors -> fs_; conceptual -> foundry_script.
# (apply BEFORE the bare gdextension rule via longest-first).
# All-caps public C API enums / build define / macros.

column4: all-caps macro/enum prefix (apply BEFORE bare GDEXTENSION)
bare all-caps build define (apply AFTER GDEXTENSION_)

column1: # Bare resource/loader format string (no dot) -> "foundryextension" (no underscore).
# Category-B residuals: embedded GDExtension tokens the word-boundary engine
# cannot reach (preceded by a letter/digit, plural forms, or mid-identifier).
# snake_case embedded (gdextension preceded by alnum, or plural gdextensions).
# Export config keys (web JS + android), kept self-consistent across .cpp/.js.
# Hyphenated CLI flags (keep hyphens; the bare rule would inject an underscore).
# Internal sentinel for the virtual-call machinery, emitted by
# core/object/make_virtuals.py. Preceded by an underscore, so the auto-scan
# word-boundary token regex cannot reach it; needs an explicit full-token rule.
# Member flag in AnimationMixer that embeds the GDVIRTUAL_CALL macro name mid-
# identifier (preceded by "is_"), so the word-boundary engine cannot reach it.

column4: embedded macro name in member flag

column1: # glTF/FBX vendor-extension and additional-data interop strings (Category D

# names or in-memory additional_data dictionary keys shared across the glTF/FBX
# importers and third-party GLTFDocumentExtensions. Renaming them would break
# reading/writing real glTF files and the importer interop contract, so they are
